No operator, licence number, or operating history for Vault Wealthholm could be confirmed from public sources. Its $250 minimum is common across the category, so it works as neither a warning nor a reassurance.

Checks to Make First

  • Use any demo mode before going live.
  • Check the registration or licence number against the actual regulator.
  • Confirm who owns and runs the platform.
